source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40; Schedule of Credits line 9 (PDF p.29)

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 28,454.00 = 28,454.00. Federal taxable income = 28,454.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 12,704.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 28,454.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 28,454.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 28,454.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 28,454.00, in the band 40,000 or less: 2,400.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,400.00 = 2,400.00. Line 5 = 28,454.00 - 2,400.00 = 26,054.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 26,054.00. Line 8a tax: 26,054.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (26,054.00 - 26,050.00 = 4.00) = 342.00 + 0.11 = 342.11. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 342.11. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 28,454.00 - 2,400.00 = 26,054.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 342.11 - 0.00 = 342.11. State income tax 342.11. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 342; expected keeps the formula result. The printed 342.00 applies from the first dollar over 26,050. The form also gives the exemption credit here (line 9, MAGI less exemptions under 30,000: 1 x 20.00), leaving 322.11; the projection does not model it, so expected stays 342.11.
accepted_approximations: Exemption credit: 20 for each exemption claimed when MAGI less exemptions is under 30,000. A low-income credit: it lowers tax only when taxable income is over 26,050 and MAGI less exemptions is under 30,000.
